description:
Higgins Builders Acoustic Baffle for Party Walls is a
high-density, custom-manufactured polyester sound absorber engineered to stop
sound transfer through ceiling voids above party walls. Manufactured in
Queensland, Australia from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibers containing up
to 85% recycled PET, it acts as a resilient acoustic barrier in
multi-residential inter-tenancy wall-to-roof junctions. Safe and itch-free to
install without protective clothing, it provides high sound transmission loss
and will not slump or deteriorate over time.

rag_summary:
Higgins Insulation Higgins Builders Baffle is a high-density
polyester acoustic sound absorber engineered specifically to stop sound transfer
through ceiling voids above party walls in Class 1 and Class 2 multi-residential
buildings. Manufactured in Queensland from 100% thermally bonded polyester
containing up to 85% recycled PET, it friction-fits between the top of the wall
and the roofline to block acoustic flanking paths. Completely itch-free,
non-toxic, hydrophobic, and fire-tested to AS/NZS 1530.3, it provides a safe,
permanent acoustic barrier between adjoining tenancies.

description:
Foil Wall Wrap Breather is a medium-duty, five-layer reflective
foil wall insulation sarking with bright aluminum foil tested to 97%
reflectivity adhered to one side. When installed with an adjacent still air gap
of at least 20mm, it creates an effective radiant heat barrier while its
micro-perforations permit moisture vapor to breathe through, reducing
condensation risks in external wall cavities. The substrate is constructed from
ultra-violet stabilized woven polypropylene with anti-oxidants and corona
treatment, providing superior tear resistance on Australian building sites.
